title: New Pogačar Documentary ‘POG1’: Before the Yellow Jerseys Came the Socks
content:
Colnago’s 'POG1: The Making of a Legend' premieres November 13 on YouTube. Tadej Pogačar’s parents, partner and mentor tell the story of his meteoric rise.

Read the full article at New Pogačar Documentary ‘POG1’: Before the Yellow Jerseys Came the Socks on Velo.
